title: Hide Internal-only changelog notes from guests and public
summary: Guests and signed-in public accounts now see a public Change Log summary only. Internal-only records, rollback notes, and GitHub issue or pull-request links stay on staff and admin directory sessions.
changes: Hide Internal-only release records from guests and signed-in public accounts on the Change Log Hub.
Hide the Internal-only filter chip and GitHub issue or pull-request links for those public audiences.
Keep the Internal-only chip, fuller notes, and GitHub links for Cloudron staff and admin directory sessions.
version_rationale: Patch release: withholds Internal-only changelog notes from guests and public accounts without changing how staff and admin directory sessions read the full history.
validation: PHPUnit ChangeLogPageTest covers guest and signed-in public withholding of Internal-only records, the Internal-only chip, rollback notes, GHSA identifiers, and GitHub issue or pull-request links, plus staff and admin visibility of those notes.
ChangeLogPresenterTest covers public-facing projection of dual-audience records and omission of Internal-only-only rows.
Ran php artisan myapes:changelog-validate against the read-only profile email parent branch for this stacked change.
known_limitations: Historical public-facing records may still mention directory or deploy work in their public summaries. SECURITY.md remains a separate v1.1.0 change.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Release history records are unchanged by rollback; guests would again see Internal-only notes on the Change Log Hub.
provenance: Defined by the changelog guest Internal-only leak task for MyAPES Account issue #122 under epic #158 and pull request #164.
